assumptions.assumption: REVIEW_ASSIST_ROLE and generated client configuration enforce the author/reviewer capability boundary.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: An author could submit or a reviewer could read transcripts, invalidating provenance separation.
assumptions.how_to_verify: Launch each generated role, enumerate registered tools, and attempt forbidden calls with and without REVIEW_ASSIST_ROLE.

assumptions.assumption: Leading XML-like blocks matched by stripInjectedBlocks are injected scaffolding rather than legitimate user content.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: A genuine opening ask can be removed from transcript previews and classification.
assumptions.how_to_verify: Test known injected wrappers and legitimate leading XML-like user messages.

assumptions.assumption: Whole-file loading in searchTranscript is acceptable for supported transcript sizes.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Large transcripts can cause latency or memory exhaustion.
assumptions.how_to_verify: Benchmark representative and maximum-size transcripts while measuring peak memory.

assumptions.assumption: SERVER_VERSION remains synchronized with package.json and published artifacts.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: CLI, MCP identity, and released package metadata can report different versions.
assumptions.how_to_verify: Add or run a release-time equality check against package metadata.

assumptions.assumption: Markdown/TOML loaders and published agents files work in bundled, npm, and MCPB artifacts.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Role definitions may fail to render or install after distribution.
assumptions.how_to_verify: Build, npm pack, inspect, install, and smoke-test role rendering from each artifact.

assumptions.assumption: Bounded head reads, mount-name matching, and an 80-candidate scoring cap retain the relevant implementation session.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Relevant sessions can remain undiscoverable or unrelated sessions can rank highly.
assumptions.how_to_verify: Exercise late mount references, name collisions, changed storage layouts, and more than 80 candidates.

requirements.text: Separate transcript custody from Intent Document submission at the server tool-registration boundary.
Generate consistent author and reviewer definitions for Claude, Codex, and generic clients.
Find implementation work in delegated, archived, and Cowork transcript storage and distinguish later distillation runs.
Support question-targeted transcript retrieval and distribute the role assets and installer CLI.

adopted.summary: Centralize shared role prose and client templates, render them through a registry, gate MCP registration with REVIEW_ASSIST_ROLE, add role/version/installation CLI surfaces, and expand transcript discovery, previews, classification, and ranked search.
adopted.rationale: Inferred from code and comments: combine client-native setup with a server-side lock, reduce role-definition drift, recover sessions previously missed by storage/layout differences, and retrieve passages relevant to reviewer questions. No implementation transcript confirms rationale or rejected alternatives.

tour.title: Define the two-agent protocol
tour.what: Adds canonical author/reviewer instructions and mandatory baseline interview questions.
tour.why: Makes provenance custody, verbatim user-ask rules, unresolved questions, and submission ownership explicit.

tour.title: Render client-native role definitions
tour.what: Adds Claude, Codex, and generic wrappers plus a registry that renders shared prose, installation metadata, environment detection, and role tool partitions.
tour.why: Keeps role behavior centralized while adapting configuration and enforcement to each client.
tour.attention: The author allowlist includes search_transcript, but shared author prose explicitly names only list/read.

tour.title: Enforce roles and expose installation surfaces
tour.what: Routes all MCP registration through the active-role gate; adds search and role-definition tools, agent installation, version reporting, and active-role diagnostics.
tour.why: Turns advisory separation into server-enforced capability separation and makes generated roles usable from supported clients.
tour.attention: Behavior when REVIEW_ASSIST_ROLE is unset remains unrestricted; interview state is process-local.

tour.title: Recover and rank more transcript sources
tour.what: Discovers Claude subagent files, archived Codex sessions, and Cowork sessions via connected mounts; increases the scoring pool, bounds candidate reads, cleans previews, flags probable distillation runs, and adds ranked passage search.
tour.why: Targets implementation sessions and delegated reasoning that prior location, cwd, recency, and paging assumptions could miss.
tour.attention: XML stripping can remove legitimate markup; search currently loads whole files despite a streaming comment; mount/cap heuristics can still miss or mis-rank sessions.

tour.title: Require role-based distillation in the guide
tour.what: Changes two-agent distillation from recommended to required and directs callers to generated role definitions.
tour.why: Aligns the authoring guide with the new enforceable workflow.

tour.title: Package role sources and text loaders
tour.what: Ships agents in npm, configures markdown/TOML bundling, and declares text module types; surrounding package.json layout changes are formatting only.
tour.why: Ensures role templates are available to builds, installers, and type checking.
tour.attention: No recovered npm/MCPB pack or install verification.

tour.title: Ignore generated local agent definitions
tour.what: Ignores repository-local Codex and Claude agent output created by agents --write.
tour.why: Prevents machine-specific generated definitions from becoming source changes.
